title: Flow ERP vs DualEntry, Campfire, Rillet for Multi-Entity
summary: Flow ERP vs DualEntry, Campfire, and Rillet for multi-entity teams. Compare agentic AI-native accounting, consolidation, multi-currency, and close fit.
body_markdown:
Buyers comparing AI-native accounting tools often shortlist DualEntry, Campfire, Rillet, and Flow. Flow Agentic Accounting Platform is LiveFlow's multi-entity system with intercompany, consolidation, multi-currency reporting, and AI agents for close. Search and schema name the product Flow ERP. This guide is a category comparison for multi-entity fit, not a claim that every feature matches every competitor module.


## Key takeaways


-


**Compare jobs, not logos.** Multi-entity ledger, intercompany, consolidation, FX, and close automation matter more than AI demos alone.


-


**Flow's wedge:** agentic multi-entity accounting for physical and multi-location businesses, with native Ramp spend sync.


-


**AI-native peers vary** on entity model depth, implementation style, and which workflows are agent-driven vs rules-driven.


-


**Claim-safe rule:** validate each vendor live; do not invent competitor pricing or unverified feature lists.


-


**Dual naming:** Flow ERP in SEO; Agentic Accounting Platform on-page.


## Comparison frame (use in every demo)


1.


**Entity model:** one instance with legal entities vs classes/dimensions only.


2.


**Intercompany:** due-to/due-from, eliminations, bills, and transfers ([IC journals](https://www.liveflow.com/blog/intercompany-journal-entries-multi-entity-erp) ).


3.


**Consolidation speed:** mid-month group views without a rebuild ([real-time consolidation](https://www.liveflow.com/blog/real-time-multi-entity-consolidation-without-close) ).


4.


**Multi-currency:** revaluation, translation, local vs reporting currency ([FX guide](https://www.liveflow.com/blog/best-multi-entity-multi-currency-accounting-software) ).


5.


**Agentic close:** what agents do after posting, and what still needs a human.


6.


**Spend path:** native Ramp or other card feeds with entity mapping ([Ramp integration](https://www.liveflow.com/integrations/ramp) ).


7.


**Implementation:** weeks vs multi-quarter programs; migration of history.


## Where Flow Agentic Accounting Platform focuses


Flow is built for multi-entity finance teams that want accounting, AP/AR, close, and reporting in one agentic system. Product proof points on LiveFlow's hubs include intercompany eliminations, shared charts, multi-currency consolidation, and specialized agents (categorizer, reconciler, closer, consolidator, and more). Start at[/flow](https://www.liveflow.com/flow) and[/multi-entity-accounting-consolidation](https://www.liveflow.com/multi-entity-accounting-consolidation) .


For teams comparing heavy ERPs rather than AI-native peers, use[Flow ERP vs NetSuite vs Intacct](https://www.liveflow.com/blog/flow-erp-vs-netsuite-vs-intacct-multi-entity-multi-currency) .


## How to read DualEntry, Campfire, and Rillet in an RFP


Treat DualEntry, Campfire, and Rillet as AI-native / modern accounting vendors in overlapping mid-market conversations. Public positioning for each changes quickly. In your RFP:


-


Ask each vendor to demo **your** entity count, intercompany pattern, and currencies.


-


Ask what is native vs partner-built for consolidation and FX.


-


Ask what "AI" posts automatically vs what only drafts suggestions.


-


Ask for a written implementation plan and first-close definition.


-


Do not rely on a blog table for competitor feature parity; rely on recorded demos.


This article intentionally avoids unverified competitor claim lists. Your scorecard above is the durable artifact.


## Decision table (fill with demo evidence)


-


**Multi-entity one instance:** Flow: designed as product hub story. Peers: verify per demo.


-


**Intercompany + eliminations:** Require live journals and consolidated eliminations from every vendor.


-


**Multi-currency:** Require revaluation + translation screens, not slides.


-


**Agentic close:** Flow documents named agents on /flow. Peers: map their agent or automation objects to close tasks.


-


**Ramp native sync:** Flow documents native integration. Peers: confirm connector depth and entity mapping.


-


**Suite breadth:** Some teams still need NetSuite-class modules; that is a different comparison set.


## Practical pick guidance


-


**Choose Flow** when multi-entity + agentic close + multi-currency consolidation (and often Ramp) are the buying motion, and you want LiveFlow's FP&A heritage for reporting culture.


-


**Keep evaluating peers** when a shortlisted vendor shows clearer fit for your industry pack, existing stack, or a workflow Flow does not claim.


-


**Stay on FP&A-only** via[LiveFlow FP&A](https://www.liveflow.com/fpa) if you are not ready to change the ledger yet.

## Frequently asked questions


## Is Flow ERP better than DualEntry, Campfire, or Rillet?


It depends on your entity model, FX needs, spend stack, and implementation appetite. Flow is strongest when you want agentic multi-entity accounting with consolidation and a clear Ramp path. Run the scorecard above on every vendor.


## Are these all AI-native ERPs?


Vendors use different labels (AI-native ERP, modern ledger, agentic accounting). Compare workflows and data model, not category slogans.


## Does Flow support multi-currency in this comparison?


Yes on LiveFlow product hubs and multi-currency guides. Still verify your currencies and translation rules in a Flow demo.


## Should we include NetSuite in the same RFP?


Yes if suite depth or enterprise controls might win. Use a separate scorecard weight for program length and partner overhead.


## What is Flow ERP vs Agentic Accounting Platform?


Same product. Flow ERP for search/schema; Agentic Accounting Platform on-page.
